messages:
Marta (People Ops): quick thought — want to run a 'Spark Swap' peer care-package exchange the week of May 12? low-effort recognition touchpoint for teams. :sparkles:
Samir: love it. what's the scope? office-only or include remote folks? :thinking_face:
Marta (People Ops): hybrid. desk-drop for office folks, ship kits for remote. aim for ~150 kits (headcount + buffer). budget idea $18 per kit.
Olivia: $18 sounds reasonable. can we mix snacks + small wellness items? allergies and dietary restrictions will matter.
Ben: +1. propose categories: snack (non-perishable), self-care (hand cream, face mask), small notebook/sticker. label 'Spark Swap' so folks know it's for peer recognition.
Kai: logistics q — do we do signups or auto-enroll and allow opt-out? signups preferred to get address + dietary info.
Marta (People Ops): sign-up form + CSV export. I can run a simple Google form. deadline May 5 to collect shipping addresses.
Jean: volunteers for assembly? I can recruit 4 folks from ops and eng to pack on May 9 afternoon. need a table, tape, labels.
Samir: i can bring the label printer and a box of mailing envelopes. will need a volunteer to coordinate ship pickups (UPS/fedex).
Olivia: remote shipping — do we cover shipping cost? that will bump the budget. estimate $6 avg per remote shipment?
Marta (People Ops): yes we cover shipping. budget estimate: (kits) 150 * $18 = $2700; shipping est remote (~40 people) * $6 = $240; total ~$2940. requesting $3k to be safe + contingency.
Ben: can we pair this with a micro-spot-award moment? like include a 'thank you' card with a spot-award QR code link to nominate a peer for a small token?
Marta (People Ops): nice idea — include printable mini-card that explains how to give a spot award and link to nom form. low friction.
Kai: timeline recap pls so folks can prep: draft form today, signups live by Friday, packing May 9, drop May 10, deliveries week of May 12. sound right?
Marta (People Ops): yep. I'll draft form tonight and share for review.
PeopleOpsBot: Budget request created (REQ-4521) — status: draft. Assigned to Marta.
Jean: packaging supplies — we have 200 kraft boxes in storage (pkg-room B). i'll reserve 150 and rest for overflow.
Olivia: dietary/allergy handling — the sign-up should have a required 'allergies or dietary restrictions' freeform field. also 'prefer vegan' checkbox.
Samir: shipping addresses — ask for preferred shipping name (some people want packages to go to partners).
Marta (People Ops): noted. i'll include fields: full name for package, shipping address, remote or office desk, dietary restrictions, opt-out checkbox.
Ben: volunteer schedule — i can do morning shift May 9 (9–12). Samir can do noon–3. who can do labeling?
Kai: i can do labeling. also can make a short slack post with photo request and a hashtag #spark-swap to collect pics.
Marta (People Ops): volunteer list so far: Jean (lead pack), Ben (morning), Samir (afternoon), Kai (labeling). need 2 more packers.
Olivia: i'll ask the communications interns if they want hours for this — they might help and take photos.
Marta (People Ops): perfect. final note: will route the budget request to finance today. any objections to the content of the kits?
Samir: please avoid scented items that are strong. keep scents minimal.
Ben: agree, skip perfumes. small unscented hand balm ok.
Marta (People Ops): got it. I'll post the signup form + budget ask link in #people-ops and pin the volunteer sign-up. thanks team! :heart:
PeopleOpsBot: Form live: https://forms.example.com/spark-swap-signup (deadline May 5).
